title: Ground Zero–Off Chops: EGW match page has a real aggregate while its event index still shows a placeholder
detail: Independent review found Ground Zero 3.44 / Off Chops 1.24 on the linked EGW match page (no-vig 26.4957% / 73.5043%), while the event schedule shows the rejected 1.8/1.8 placeholder. Candidate 50bb2017c3ed instead carries a low-confidence own-network estimate (44.9373% / 55.0627%). A dated, hash-checked reviewed capture is retained under data/research/e57df95b/reference-odds.json for final integration through the existing reference rung; it is not a first-party quote and must expire after eight hours. Smarkets confirms exact identity/start but both spreads exceed 0.15, so it remains guidance only.
